items.description:
Lightning is about five times hotter than the surface of the Sun: about 27,800 °C against 5,500 °C. Count the seconds from flash to thunder and divide by 3: that's how many km away it struck. Images: B. Morgan (CC0); A. Parlette, Rollingskyphoto (CC BY 4.0, cropped); M. Madau, Grand Canyon NPS (public domain); NASA/SDO & HMI team; NSO/NSF/AURA (CC BY 4.0, cropped); NASA; NASA Earth Observatory.
